boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 145 layers frame counters around a center pink `20` pair, with a bottom combo bar alternating between `6` and `4` as matched groups clear. The combo bar is the real constraint: it must read `6` before the pink pair breaks, or the first combo wastes and the left yellow strip locks in place. A pink troll marker tracks the active clear zone — finish on the red 2×2 and blue `9` for PERFECT.
landmarks: Block Out Level 145 layers frame counters around a center pink `20` pair, with a bottom combo bar alternating between `6` and `4` as matched groups clear.
The combo bar is the real constraint: it must read `6` before the pink pair breaks, or the first combo wastes and the left yellow strip locks in place.
A pink troll marker tracks the active clear zone — finish on the red 2×2 and blue `9` for PERFECT.

quickTips: Start the combo bar at 6 before breaking the center 20/20 pair.
Clear the green L-shape before peeling the left yellow strip above it.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the top pink up-arrow block and the upper red/yellow row to start the combo bar at 6.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Break the center pink 20/20 pair without shifting the side yellow stacks.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Clear the upper blue/green vertical columns through the left 2 rail counter.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Peel the left green L-shape and the blue L-shape below it once the top 6 counter drops.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Clear the right-side red 2×2 block beside the 1 label through the 10 right-rail counter.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Spend the bottom 9 box and the 18 corner counter on the remaining blue scraps.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Match the last highlighted group for the PERFECT clear with a score of 20.

failurePoints: Breaking the center 20 pair while the combo bar still reads 0, wasting the first combo.
Clearing the left yellow strip before the green L-shape below it breaks, stranding the red 2×2.
